page_title: GET 1-1 BAR | Getafe v Barcelona 18/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+9' Raphinha (Barcelona) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.

90+8' Christantus Uche (Getafe) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the middle of the goal is, however, saved by Inaki Pena!
90+6' Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
90+5' Ismael Bekhoucha (Getafe) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
90+5' Raphinha (Barcelona) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
90+5' Referee Pablo Fuertes has finally had enough of Hansi Flick and brandishes a yellow card at him!
90+5' Referee Pablo Fuertes halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Jose Bordalas Jimenez, then shows him a yellow.
90+2' A substitution has been made. Coba Gomez da Costa is replaced by Ismael Bekhoucha (Getafe).
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
90' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
89' Raphinha (Barcelona) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.

89' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Barcelona.
89' Pedri (Barcelona) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
88' Christantus Uche (Getafe) latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box, but miskicks his shot and the ball goes high over the bar. Poor effort!
86' Djene (Getafe) gets booked for the first time in this match.
86' Christantus Uche (Getafe) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
84' Raphinha (Barcelona) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
84' Raphinha (Barcelona) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Barcelona.
83' Raphinha (Barcelona) gets on the end of a cross from Lamine Yamal, but his shot goes a whisker wide of the left post.
81' Substitution. Ferran Torres (Barcelona) replaces Robert Lewandowski.
81' PENALTY APPEAL after Jules Kounde (Barcelona) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
81' Raphinha (Barcelona) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.

80' Frenkie de Jong (Barcelona) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going in the top right corner, but David Soria has other ideas and makes a brilliant save. The ball is out of play. Barcelona win a corner kick.
80' 7:16 – the total goal attempt statistics. We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 3:4.
77' Raphinha (Barcelona) tries to bend in the free kick from the edge of the box, but the defensive wall makes an easy block.
76' Domingos Duarte (Getafe) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Pablo Fuertes signals. Barcelona earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
75' Diego Rico (Getafe) is in a clear offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
75' Luis Milla (Getafe) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
74' Luis Milla (Getafe) swings in a cross from the corner, but Inaki Pena reads it well and gathers the ball. The ball is out of play. Getafe will have a chance to score from a corner.
73' Diego Rico (Getafe) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Now Getafe have a corner.
73' The attendance for today's match is 15134.

69' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous low effort towards the middle of the goal is blocked by David Soria, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
67' Carles Perez plays a short pass through to Djene (Getafe) inside the box, but he balloons his effort high over the bar.
66' Jose Bordalas Jimenez has decided to substitute Carles Alena and he is replaced by Carles Perez (Getafe).
66' Substitution. Yellu Santiago makes his way off the pitch and Alvaro Rodriguez (Getafe) comes on as his replacement.
65' Domingos Duarte (Getafe) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
65' Frenkie de Jong (Barcelona) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to David Soria, who smothers the ball.
63' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) receives a reproachful look from Frenkie de Jong. He latches on to his pass, but the effort from the edge of the box sails high over the crossbar.
62' Hansi Flick has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Dani Olmo (Barcelona) replacing Gavi.
61' Christantus Uche (Getafe) has a great chance to score from deep inside the box! He finds some space for the shot, but sends it errantly way past the left post. Very poor attempt.
58' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Pedri (Barcelona) takes it short.
57' Half-chance! Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) plays a pass into the box, but David Soria reacts well to snuff out the attack.
55' The resulting corner from Raphinha (Barcelona) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
54' The resulting corner from Raphinha (Barcelona) comes to nothing.
53' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
53' Yellu Santiago (Getafe) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
51' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Raphinha (Barcelona) offside.
49' Jose Bordalas Jimenez is forced to make a change. Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) is unable to continue due to injury, Yellu Santiago comes on.
49' Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
47' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) fires the ball towards the right side of the goal from close-range, but his shot is blocked by one of the defenders.
47' Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) is the one to unleash a good effort towards the bottom right corner. His shot, however, is saved by the goalkeeper. What a save!
46' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe) but poses no threat.
46' Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The ball is out of play. Barcelona will take a throw-in.
46' Half-time substitution. Marc Casado (Barcelona) will not participate anymore and Frenkie de Jong is coming on.
46' Referee Pablo Fuertes blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
42' Luis Milla (Getafe) attempts to find Coba Gomez da Costa with a delicate little through ball from inside the box, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
41' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Ronald Araujo.
40' Coba Gomez da Costa (Getafe) touches the ball with his hand. It's a free kick to Barcelona in a dangerous position.
39' Diego Rico (Getafe) has the ability to send the ball deep into the penalty area from throw-ins and it can lead to very promising situations for his team.
38' Coba Gomez da Costa (Getafe) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
37' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) is flagged for offside once again, but it was a very tight call this time.
35' No offside! Referee Pablo Fuertes points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. That prompts big celebrations from the Getafe players.
35' The Getafe players halt their celebrations as referee Pablo Fuertes makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.

34' 1 - 1 Coba Gomez da Costa fires in a promising shot which ricochets off the goalkeeper back to Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) inside the box and he sends the ball into the back of the net. The score is 1:1.
34' Luis Milla (Getafe) fails to deliver a decent cross from a long-range free kick. The opposition's defence intercepts the effort.
33' What a chance that is! Jules Kounde swings the ball into the box, and Raphinha (Barcelona) gets in front of his man and powers his header just wide of the left post.
31' Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The ball is out of play. Getafe will have a throw-in.
29' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.

27' Coba Gomez da Costa (Getafe) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Barcelona.
26' Coba Gomez da Costa (Getafe) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
24' The total number of attempts is 1:6. The current number of shots on goal is 0:3.
22' Christantus Uche (Getafe) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.
18' Gavi (Barcelona) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Gavi (Barcelona) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar.
15' The corner kick is deflected to Alejandro Balde (Barcelona), who immediately sends in a long-range shot. However, he hits the ball poorly and it goes high over the bar.
15' Raphinha (Barcelona) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
14' Raphinha (Barcelona) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence. It will be a corner kick for Barcelona.
12' Pedri (Barcelona) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Jules Kounde, but he can't get on the end of the pass. The ball goes out of play and Getafe will have a goal kick.
12' Raphinha (Barcelona) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
9' 0 - 1 Goal 0:1! Jules Kounde (Barcelona) taps home from close range after the rebound fell kindly into his path.
9' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) receives a pass inside the box, controls the ball and drills it towards the left post. Unfortunately for him, David Soria makes a great save to stop his effort.
8' Raphinha (Barcelona) takes the corner with a short pass.

7' Raphinha (Barcelona) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. The ball goes out of play. Barcelona are awarded a corner kick.
7' Carles Alena (Getafe) finds himself some space and fires in a superb first-time shot from long range towards the right side of the goal. Inaki Pena is alert and makes a good save to deny him.
4' Coba Gomez da Costa (Getafe) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked.
4' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Lamine Yamal (Barcelona), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
1' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) latches onto a nice cross into the area around the penalty spot, but plants his header just over the bar.
